Same as 1, but the group is defined over films that have been rented (a join through inventory and rental), so films are weighted by rentals.

queries: SELECT AVG(length), AVG(replacement_cost / rental_rate) FROM film WHERE length >= 112
SELECT rating, AVG(replacement_cost) / AVG(rental_rate) FROM film GROUP BY rating;
SELECT rating, SUM(replacement_cost) / SUM(rental_rate) FROM film GROUP BY rating;
SELECT rating, AVG(rental_rate), AVG(length) FROM film WHERE length IS NOT NULL GROUP BY rating

SELECT AVG(length) AS avg_length,
       AVG(CASE WHEN rental_rate IS NOT NULL AND rental_rate <> 0 THEN rental_rate / replacement_cost END) AS avg_ratio
FROM film
WHERE length >= 112
